title: Sharp threshold property
statement: Let $d:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, and let $(f_k)_{k\in\mathbb N}$ be a family of Boolean functions such that each $f_k$ is monotone and nonconstant on the $d(k)$-dimensional cube. For $0<\epsilon<\tfrac12$, the family has a sharp threshold if its normalized threshold widths converge to zero as $k\to\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $k$, a Boolean function on the $d(k)$-dimensional cube
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the critical probability or bias-variance scale used in the normalized widths.
